# anthropic_api_keys (Data Source)

Lists Claude Console API keys in the organization (`GET /v1/organizations/api_keys`), with optional filtering by `workspace_id`, `status`, or `created_by_user_id`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created_by_user_id` (String) Optional filter by creator user ID (`user_...`).
- `status` (String) Optional status filter (`active`, `inactive`, `archived`).
- `workspace_id` (String) Optional workspace ID filter (`wrkspc_...`).

### Read-Only

- `api_keys` (Attributes List) List of organization API keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--api_keys))

<a id="nestedatt--api_keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `api_keys`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the API key was created.
- `created_by_id` (String) ID of the user or service account that created the API key.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the API key.
- `name` (String) Display name of the API key.
- `partial_key_hint` (String) Partially redacted hint of the API key.
- `status` (String) Operational status of the API key.
- `type` (String) Object type (`api_key`).
- `workspace_id` (String) Workspace ID the API key belongs to, or `null` for the default workspace.
